descriptions.w3d_null_instance_not_implemented: Returns the not-implemented status code; a default virtual method.
descriptions.w3d_null_instance_owner_flags: Returns the first flag byte reported by the instance's owner object.
descriptions.w3d_null_instance_shutdown: Unregisters an XNullInstance from the scene list, runs base shutdown and detaches it from its owner.
descriptions.w3d_null_instance_unbind: Clears the instance's bound marker and the bound flag on its scene node's render state.
